wth.text: Tahngarth, a Talruum minotaur, first met the Weatherlight when it crash-landed in the Talruum Mountains, where he fought as Sisay's champion, defeated Ghentoth and joined her crew, and he became her first mate after Meida was killed in the Adarkar Wastes.
When Gerrard quit the crew, Tahngarth admitted that the Weatherlight needs Gerrard, and Gerrard later rejoined and appointed Tahngarth first mate.

The Weatherlight was ambushed and boarded by the Predator at Rath, whose crew took Karn, Tahngarth and the Legacy artifacts hostage, and he was later freed by the rescue party, which found only a shapeshifter in place of Sisay.
Tahngarth kills Greven as the Predator is sent crashing into the Stronghold, and he returns mutilated, carrying the wounded Mirri and Crovax.

plc.text: Gerrard hears Tahngarth roaring at a missionary of the Church of Angelfire on the docks, talks him out of killing the missionary, and the two are reunited.
Tahngarth tells Gerrard they came to find him because something terrible has happened to Sisay.
Later he helps rescue Starke from Maraxus's camp, carries the weakened Starke through a canyon, and is sent with Crovax and Starke back to the ship while Gerrard faces Maraxus alone.
